Story of Saint Tulsidas
• Experience the Profound Wisdom of the Upanishads!**
Available in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam & Hindi
Select your preferred audio track from the settings menu!
In this enlightening episode of *Upanishad Ganga*, we explore **the immense value and glory of human birth**, as depicted through the transformative journey of *Tulsidas Ji*. This episode beautifully weaves together spiritual wisdom, devotion, and the deeper meaning of life, illustrating how human birth is an opportunity to attain the highest realization.
